name: Notebook Tabs
tagline: A cream paper sheet with binder holes on a dark desk, pastel section tabs with vertical labels on the right edge, and Bodoni headlines. Adapted from the Notebook Tabs preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: a cream paper sheet with a soft shadow on a charcoal desk, near-black type, and five pastel tab colors (mint, lavender, pink, sky, cream) — one per section — used for the tabs, highlighter marks, chart highlights and section cards

typography.style: high-contrast Bodoni Moda (700 headlines with 400 italic phrases) for an editorial feel, paired with a clean DM Sans for body text, item titles and tracked uppercase labels

best_for: Research readouts, report briefings, courses and workshops, project plans, board papers and editorial reviews — decks with clear sections that people may page back through. Strong for contents pages, findings, tables, checklists and quotes.
avoid_for: High-energy launches, keynotes on huge stages and very dark rooms. The paper sheet and pastel tabs read as calm and studious, not loud.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
